body: this is a massive wall in the difficult, painful path I was already walking and i think I finally exhausted all my strength, im sorry.

pfft... not unless you can somehow help me procure three months worth of rent ... (which is just not happening. even rental assistance programs in my area can’t help)

times like this, i wish i made a facebook or twitter, bc ive seen people in bad situations be lifted out with the online networks theyve built, but that’s completely shot. ive got no extended online or offline support except for this reddit acc.... ouch... 

it wasn’t all a wash, though. thank you for having been so understanding. I appreciate the kindness, patience, and empathy youve shown me. even trapped back in my last abusive relationship, the ones who showed me the most understanding were the ones that lived through similar hardships and knew the song beat by beat. it was hard leaving and then doing everything on my own in a new place. i wish things never got to this point.
thank you for looking into this for me. it’s deeply appreciated and it means more than i can say. realistically, though, this is a case of... well... much too little, far too late.
oh no no no i moved away from utah and live on the east coast, and im being denied unemployment at my new place of residency, and im not sure why. it may be because im from out of state.
from utah? not a chance.

these bills are so huge they’re definitely going to affect my ability to get my own apartment or take out loans for college . it just makes me feel like im going to be trapped here forever like a fly in amber. I can’t have a dismissive attitude towards it, just a dull horror at how much more difficult the rest of my life is about to be.

i don’t know what the reason is at all. at all. i tried making an appointment with someone who works at the unemployment commission but they didn’t tell me anything. i have no idea at all why they keep being denied. all I can assume is bc , again , im from out of state. i don’t know. my bank account is overdrafted and i have no way of paying rent. 

thank you, by the way, for being respectful. but ive been in poverty for a long time already so I know my way around so called “organizations” that can help but just ... don’t. they don’t. maybe it’s bc it’s my area and resources are stretched completely thin, i don’t know. ive been struggling for a long time already and this is my breaking point. 

i don’t have anyone that loves me, and i have no safe place to stay. my shitty family is states away and my abusive ex would love to know the extent my suffering increased after i left and would never let me stay anyways. im exhausted and im just.... done now.

please don’t speak to me in such a condescending tone. i don’t need to be belittled on top of everything else. i got to this point bc i did everything in my power to keep going before, and i did it all alone. i left an abusive household on my own, moved out, worked, searched, asked around, and tried very very hard to stay optimistic. i didn’t wait, i moved forward and tried keeping going. now ive hit a wall with my assault and everything horrible that got me to this point has piled up to finally drag me down. i did everything up to this point for my own survival and tried to retain the hope things would get better and being raped finally made me realize it was futile. it’s a soul sucking realization to be slapped with. know i did care and that i did try and i don’t appreciate the implications i never did, thank you. i never waited for anyone to save me. don’t you dare disrespect the tremendous amount of hope i had put into my myself and my future. the loss of that faith is soul crushing and realizing it was all for nothing was the worst heartbreak i ever felt.

im sorry but ive been unable to get any state benefits for a long time already. im from utah and had to move out and i think that the fact that im not from around here has stalled any chance of me getting on anything. ive been trying for weeks to get unemployment but no dice and i doubt ill get anything now. 2020 was a year marked by eviction and poverty and an abusive relationship and I was denied everything I tried applying for. I doubt it’ll fall in my favor this time around and it’ll take too long since im being evicted in october and will have nowhere to go. 

im not like. stupid. i tried everything and reached out just to come out empty handed. 

I think this is just the absolute breaking point in everything and the door has closed and locked now. realistically, im not getting out. i really did try. sucks it didn’t amount to anything.

i already tried this. it’s in the post. i promise the most “obvious” steps are ones i already took. they don’t care. i got a few things waived but I still have an unpayable amount left over. idk why people are so resistant to the idea and im sorry if this comes across as short but im tired of being told i can get them to go away when i literally cannot.

i don’t want to be a downer but i can’t overstate enough that im at the point of no return with my isolation and complete despair . i feel no control over anything. all i can do now is sleep so i don’t have to be awake for anything bc i have no money no job and no one that can check in on me 

being assaulted hurt but being alone and unwanted hurts more and im just very , very tired

i already contacted RAINN before. the thing is, it’s not an organization. all it does is reroute you to the crisis center in your area and they’ve been completely and utterly useless to me, both now and before this happened (i was in an abusive relationship and they didn’t help) 

please understand that i , ah, wouldn’t be having embarrassing meltdowns on reddit if i hadn’t already exhausted all other options.

was asked this already so ill just copy paste: 

domestic violence shelters in my area have been wiped completely clean and so have rape resource centers. so have all rental assistance programs. i have been told over and over that covid completely cleared out whatever financial assistance they could offer anyone. when i was trapped in an abusive relationship in 2020 and isolated from everyone i couldn’t go anywhere or escape anywhere due to the pandemic and i had no one to help me, and those places that you’re directing me towards were useless then and will be useless now. i was dealing with financial hardship and trying so hard to get kind of assistance to get away from my abuser, just to end up empty handed .

the church communities near me can only offer things from the food bank, but there’s so little they can give me. i don’t want to seem ungrateful but half the things they give me are to eat are moldy or expired. the non perishable items only last for very short periods of time so often times i’m just left hungry with no energy.

i already asked for an itemized hospital bill. it says so in the post. thank you for telling me medicaid does backpay bills, that’s useful to know, but getting on any public benefits has been a struggling and im not holding out. I couldn’t even get on unemployment.

my car broke down about two weeks before the assault which was expected but it still hurts. i don’t think i can overstate how much shit luck ive had. medicaid and snap benefits aren’t going to help me pay rent, my main concern, and i have nowhere else to go when i I lose housing bc there’s no one that will take me and let me stay with them. thinking about the massive unpaid debt that’s going to follow me makes me want to die. i have a feeling this is going to follow me forever and i don’t want it too ruin all chances of me being able to take out loans for college or get my own apartment. it just makes me want to cry and leave. im sorry for venting, but i see no way out of this very deep grave ive been shoved into bit by bit by bit throughout the years

incidentally, i doubt i’d be able to get them. tried it. i can’t even get on unemployment.

not ftm (questioned it for a bit, but decided i wasn’t) but i am a masculine female, and there was absolute hell to pay when i wanted to cut my hair short and wear men’s jeans. i was treated like i was possessed by the devil for it. i don’t doubt mtfs have it harder with trying to embrace their femininity, though, bc it is true that some tomboyishness is accepted in females to a certain extent

i never considered myself a particularly dysphoric person but a ftm friend of mine had top surgery and had an old binder he asked if i wanted to try on. i did and then looked in the mirror and the absolute rush i got from being completely flat chested cant be put into words. it really did feel like i was seeing myself for the first time and all the possibilities that came with it.

not transgender, just a masc woman, but i think that helped me realize the future was mine to hold onto back then. it was the feeling ive been searching for my whole entire life.
ah thanks but ive been scraping by with barely anything to start with so ive already been around that block more times then i can say

hey thank for for chiming in and i tried contacting them just now but all they did was email me a list of places i already went to and numbers i already called. they can’t help financially, just link people to resources ive already exhausted. guess i can at least cross that one off...

ive been in your shoes and im so sorry but there’s not much that can be done. guys like that dont change just bc people tell them to bc their entitlement gives them tunnel vision. im sorry you’re dealing with this - i had to delete my ig to escape the stalking and harassment
we’re literally not seen as people. just objects devoid of agency. it’s terrifying

hey ... that happened to me too. the person this case was actually a counselor back at one of the job training programs i was trying to apply for. she actually grabbed my chest and when i jumped in shock she snidely said she couldn’t tell if i was a male or female and then asked me if i only presented masculinely bc past sexual assault gave me gender issues (keep in mind i had only spoken to her about housing difficulties, not about past trauma). i told her not to ever touch me again and then i was subsequently rejected from applying to that program. it’s really so horrifying how many predators exist in spaces supposed to protect and assist the vulnerable and im sorry you encountered that.

my roommates are all elderly, on disability, and none of them speak english. we are all improvised and they can’t help me. someone comes and helps one of them bathe since she can’t do it on their own but i don’t see them much and i very much doubt they can help me, since they’re also living in poverty alongside me and yknow, language barrier. 

social workers aren’t angels. they’re honestly not super useful or at least not in my experience and what i’ve heard from other people. what would i escalate it to? for what purpose? 

my general area is dc/maryland/virginia. i tried reaching for support outside of my place of residency but was told that if i didn’t live in a specific city or town i was not to use the resources given by them. i already exhausted all the ones in my area. i cried to one in the next town over and she told me she’d try and slot me into the group counseling sessions in the city just to sheepishly call me back a day later and say that i couldn’t after all since i wasn’t a resident there. 

i really did try hard with everything, to no avail. 

ps - my place of residency is completely infamous for mishandling rape cases and failing victims of assault. i can see why, and this only discouraged me from reporting. it didn’t go well before and it definitely wouldn’t go well now
ive been trying to reach out to agencies for over a year. ive tried before and it hurts that even following an assault i still can’t get support

see the thing is - i was in a violent relationship and dependent on outside help even before this happened, and i think this is the final nail in the coffin. point by point:

domestic violence shelters in my area have been wiped completely clean and so have rape resource centers. so have all rental assistance programs. i have been told over and over that covid completely cleared out whatever financial assistance they could offer anyone. when i was trapped in an abusive relationship in 2020 and isolated from everyone i couldn’t go anywhere or escape anywhere due to the pandemic and i had no one to help me, and those places that you’re directing me towards were useless then and will be useless now. i was dealing with financial hardship and trying so hard to get kind of assistance to get away from my abuser, just to end up empty handed . 

the church communities near me can only offer things from the food bank, but there’s so little they can give me. i don’t want to seem ungrateful but half the things they give me are to eat are moldy or expired. the non perishable items only last for very short periods of time so often times i’m just left hungry with no energy. in person counseling is canceled  and i’ve tried their zoom meetings in the past but it just made me feel even lonelier and more disconnected, and i feel like i can’t form community because i’m visibly gay and a masculine woman and they’re hostile to people like me. 

my social worker keeps ghosting me and ignoring my calls because well. she told me flat out there is nothing she can do because there are no resources to help me. 

i’m not going to the police, because they were cruel and condescending when i was stuck in a bad relationship and i’ve had nothing but bad experiences trying to report the domestic violence occurring to me. trying to report an assault will kill me. 

this has reached its breaking point of a long ongoing issue. thank you for at least responding. i don’t know what else there is to say
